summary: Stranded dirt-bike rider in the Taylor Park area; Western Mountain Search and Rescue engaged around 9:00 p.m. and escorted the party out of the wilderness by 5:00 a.m. the following morning.
responding_agency: Western Mountain Search and Rescue; Gunnison County Sheriff Office
notes: GCSO weekly blotter entry 07/11/18 (parent-opened run 615); escort completed 5:00 a.m. 2018-07-12. Fills thin year 2018 for Gunnison.
